```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
df <- read_csv("../../data/processed/merged_data/soil_crop_acreage_panel_2017_2024.csv",
               show_col_types = FALSE)

# basic checks
dim(df)
head(df)

# key checks
sort(unique(df$year))
n_distinct(df$county_fips)
n_distinct(df$crop_code)
```



```{r}
crop_totals <- df %>%
  group_by(crop_code) %>%
  summarise(
    total_area = sum(acreage_area_proxy, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_area))

head(crop_totals, 10)
```

```{r}
# Top 5 crops
TOP_K <- 5
top_crops <- crop_totals %>%
  slice_head(n = TOP_K) %>%
  pull(crop_code)

top_crops
```
Step 3 — Acreage distribution of major crops
```{r}
crop_totals %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(crop_code = factor(crop_code, levels = crop_code)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = crop_code, y = total_area)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Crops by Total Acreage (Area Proxy)",
    x = "Crop code",
    y = "Total acreage (area proxy)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
Step 4 — Subset data to major crops
```{r}
df_top <- df %>%
  filter(crop_code %in% top_crops)

dim(df_top)
```
```{r}
names(df)[grepl("muaggatt", names(df))]
```


Step 5 — Define soil variables of interest
```{r}
soil_vars <- c(
  "gSSURGO_NY — muaggatt_slopegradwta",
  "gSSURGO_NY — muaggatt_brockdepmin",
  "gSSURGO_NY — muaggatt_wtdepannmin",
  "gSSURGO_NY — muaggatt_wtdepaprjunmin"
)


soil_vars <- soil_vars[soil_vars %in% names(df)]
soil_vars
```
6. Boxplots：soil × crop
```{r}
for (sv in soil_vars) {
  p <- ggplot(
    df_top,
    aes(x = factor(crop_code), y = .data[[sv]])
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Soil distribution by crop:", sv),
      x = "Crop code",
      y = sv
    ) +
    theme_bw()

  print(p)
}
```



Step 7 — Soil vs acreage (continuous relationship)
```{r}
crop_focus <- top_crops[1]
df_focus <- df %>%
  filter(crop_code == crop_focus)

for (sv in soil_vars) {
  p <- ggplot(
    df_focus,
    aes(x = .data[[sv]], y = acreage_area_proxy)
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Soil vs Acreage (Crop =", crop_focus, "):", sv),
      x = sv,
      y = "Acreage (area proxy)"
    ) +
    theme_bw()

  print(p)
}

```
Step 8 — Compare soil–acreage slopes across crops

```{r}
soil_focus <- soil_vars[1]  # 比如 slopegradwta

ggplot(
  df_top,
  aes(
    x = .data[[soil_focus]],
    y = acreage_area_proxy,
    color = factor(crop_code)
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Soil vs Acreage across crops:", soil_focus),
    x = soil_focus,
    y = "Acreage (area proxy)",
    color = "Crop code"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

```

```{r}
soil_focus_ann <- "gSSURGO_NY — muaggatt_wtdepannmin"

ggplot(
  df_top,
  aes(
    x = .data[[soil_focus_ann]],
    y = acreage_area_proxy,
    color = factor(crop_code)
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Soil vs Acreage across crops: Annual Minimum Water-Table Depth",
    x = "Annual minimum depth to water table",
    y = "Acreage (area proxy)",
    color = "Crop code"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

```
